status: Level Design implementation recommendation; numeric tuning requires Engineering checks, not a shipped feature
scope: Existing first-level geometry and implemented roles only. Engineering owns runtime, roadmap and delivery.

ownership_rule.coordinate: Hero left-edge world x, matching existing TRIGGERS and checkpoint activation.
ownership_rule.before: Authored ownership trigger below 4650 belongs to start.
ownership_rule.after: Authored ownership trigger at or above 4650 belongs to checkpoint-4650.
ownership_rule.stable: Assign ownership before randomization. Never infer ownership from current actor or spawn position.
ownership_rule.straddling_wave: Seven entries before checkpoint, one at 4700 after it; retain eight total baseline entries.
ownership_rule.opening: All 12 existing opening events belong to start; preserve existing triggers and 3120 expiry.
ownership_rule.swarm: Existing swarm home 4400 and bounds 4140..4570 belong to start; exclude on checkpoint retry.
ownership_rule.removed_swarm: Do not restore the obsolete 2090 swarm in the integrated level.

reset_transaction: Choose origin from already activated checkpoint, not death position; reset route high-water mark to origin.
Clear every live actor including earlier pursuers, corpses, particles, both projectile sets and swarm contact cooldown.
Clear warnings, reservations, attack tokens, retry clocks, event counters and actor-to-event references together.
Restore full-HP pending events whose owner is at or after origin, even if previously killed, issued or bypassed.
Mark earlier owned events excluded for this retry; do not count them as killed, issued or waiting.
Keep seed and resolved event IDs, roles, trigger offsets and entrance preference lists unchanged.
Reset encounter clocks and local kill accounting; lifetime analytics may remain separate from attempt counters.
Use existing one-time life debit; preserve hero, difficulty, checkpoint and clone stock, with no introduction replay.
Do not reset consumed dispenser stock through a broad reset_game call. Cancel transient presentation safely.
Restore normal gameplay only after reset and dispenser transition complete; no scheduling during transition.

checkpoint_reentry.conditions: Require both progress and control-time guards. Pause, death and dispenser time do not count.
checkpoint_reentry.first_entry: Forward only after checkpoint retry; no rear fallback for the 4700 entry.
checkpoint_reentry.later_entries: Any rear entrance must remain wholly within the active segment and obey existing readable-entry rules.
checkpoint_reentry.safe_distance: Retain at least 220 pixels between rendered threat edge and hero body; retain checkpoint exclusion.
checkpoint_reentry.checkpoint_exclusion: Existing center exclusion is +/-200; additionally reject rendered overlap with cabinet or protected area.
checkpoint_reentry.geometry: 4850..5730 is a continuous stepped obstacle cluster; no invented ground spawn inside it.
checkpoint_reentry.safe_forward_lane: The next open floor beyond that cluster starts at 5730. Validate body and art clearance.
checkpoint_reentry.defer: 4700 is eligibility, not guaranteed spawn. Use actual camera/body/geometry checks before insertion.
checkpoint_reentry.expiry: At route progress 4800, bypass any unissued straddling-wave entry without kill credit; never move it into the pump wave.
checkpoint_reentry.reason: Only 150 pixels remain after checkpoint; preserve flow rather than force a spawn into that short interval.
checkpoint_reentry.optional_on_retry: Intentional: steady forward movement bypasses the 4700 tail event before the 1.25-second grace ends. Tony at270 pixels/second reaches4987.5 and Sean at235 reaches4943.75 from4650 in that time. It may issue only if the player lingers below4800 after grace and a forward entrance is safe. Restoring an event to pending is not a promise that it must spawn. Do not shorten protection, extend expiry or relocate it into the next wave to force its appearance.
checkpoint_reentry.next_wave: Apply the same initial retry grace to all encounter issuance, including the4900 pump wave. After grace, the pump wave resumes its own safe cadence; skip expired entries without a catch-up burst.

seeded_variants.resolve_once: Resolve a serializable manifest from seed, difficulty and layout revision at new-run start.
seeded_variants.death: Reuse that manifest; reset event-local RNG and clocks. Safety retries must not reroll roles or triggers.
seeded_variants.reproducibility: Same seed and input trajectory reproduce choices; different movement may defer or bypass safely.
seeded_variants.ownership: Variant trigger offsets cannot cross 4650, swap event order or pass expiry; pin 4700 entry.
seeded_variants.placement: Resolve authored candidate preferences, not unconditional spawn coordinates; rerun live safety checks.
seeded_variants.easy: Fixed subset/order and entrance preferences, fewer entries and longer stagger; omit entries explicitly in manifest.
seeded_variants.normal: Baseline counts 8/10/10/8; bounded trigger and entrance variants within each owned segment.
seeded_variants.hard: Use broader validated combinations and shorter spacing; preserve caps and warnings, no overdue burst.
seeded_variants.species: Only substitute where role habitat is valid. No perched shooter on pump props without validated perch support.
role_constraints: Floor emerger needs an unoccupied visible marker and reachable escape; recheck before damage begins.
Widow needs verified 60x48 flight clearance and its existing tell/dive/recovery; one active Widow maximum.
With a Widow, preserve crowd cap 6; otherwise do not exceed existing integrated cap 8.
Keep current shooter, hostile-bullet and independent-pattern budgets from balance data; reserve before warning.
No simultaneous front/rear trap during checkpoint reentry or unavoidable crossfire over a mandatory landing.
seeded_variants.unchanged: HP, weapon damage, player movement, attack tells, scenery and checkpoint location.
seeded_variants.fallback: If a variant has no proven valid habitat, use a safe runner or omit it; never silently weaken safety.
seeded_variants.tuning_status: Exact Easy counts, variant weights and mode intervals are Engineering/Mechanics tuning, pending tests.

acceptance: Stable unique IDs: 36 later events, split 7 start / 29 checkpoint; no duplicate ownership.
Death before checkpoint restores all opening events, 4400 swarm and later events at full HP.
Death after checkpoint excludes all opening, 4400 swarm and first seven later entries, even if they pursued ahead.
Post-checkpoint reset includes 4700 entry and all 28 later-wave entries, including defeated/bypassed entries.
At x4649 checkpoint inactive; activated at x4650; verify exact boundary and same-tick lethal crossing ordering.
On retry no event issues at x4650; 4700 event needs control grace plus live safe entrance and expires at4800.
Cross whole trigger intervals in one tick: bounded issue cadence; no backlog dump or unintended completion quota.
Repeated deaths preserve resolved manifest and consumed clone stock; no old shots/tokens/particles survive.
Both heroes and all modes pass headless checks; foreground fairness review remains separately permission-gated.
At constant270/235 movement from4650, the first tail entry expires before1.25 seconds; this intentional bypass earns no kill credit. A stationary retry emits no threat during grace.
validation: JSON, IDs, counts, bounds and ownership checked locally; no gameplay build, launch or visual validation performed.
